sentences.text: Dynamopterus velox is an extinct bird known only from a single large right humerus found in France. This bone shares anatomical features with living cuckoos but is much larger.
The genus Dynamopterus belongs to the parent group Idiornithidae. It has been classified in the suborder Cariamae within the order Gruiformes.
The genus Dynamopterus lived from the Lutetian to the Chattian stages, between 48.07 and 23.04 million years ago.
It is debated whether some fossils previously identified as Dynamopterus tuberculatus actually belong to the newly identified group Perplexicervicidae.
